newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin Q3 net loss 507 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Serfin Q3 net loss 507 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Serfin reported on Sunday a third quarter net loss of 507 million pesos, mostly due to a 700 million peso charge at its bank unit for building reserves.

Mexico's third largest financial group said in a statement that its bank unit, Banca Serfin, suffered a third quarter net loss of 598 million pesos. It said the bank unit's quarterly profit of 102 million pesos before provisions was more than offset by the charge for building reserves against bad loans.
Serfin said its bank unit's reserves against past-due loans stood at 103 percent at the end of the third quarter compared to 100 percent at the end of the second quarter.
It added that Banca Serfin's capitalization ratio was 12.3 percent at September 30 versus 11.9 percent at the end of the second quarter.
Analysts had predicted a tough quarter for the bank, which has worked to recapitalize the balance sheet this year to protect against growing past-due loans due to Mexico's recession.
The statement did not say if Serfin's past-due loans grew during the quarter, as analysts were expecting.
The financial group's brokerage, Operadora de Bolsa Serfin, racked up a net profit of 57 million pesos during the quarter versus a net profit of 41 million pesos during the second quarter.
The group's insurance and bond companies registered profits of 32 million and 15 million pesos, respectively.
The statement also said Serfin was seeking buyers for 49 percent of the insurance business and all of the bond business.
